title: Deficit irrigation: a water limit against the trigger
intro: A crop can be given a limited amount of water in the season, and irrigation starts only when the soil water pressure is below the trigger. A strict trigger with a small limit, against a lax trigger with a large limit, shows whether the same water gives more yield when it is saved for the dry spell.
